intent: Independently review the homepage Reel-card repair: when a supported video card reaches the visible rail it must show the real muted inline YouTube player and loop; the card must not render fabricated progress or duplicate play controls.

brief.visitor: A prospective client viewing the selected-work reel carousel on a phone.
brief.promise: The first video visibly plays in place when it reaches the screen, with one clear way to open the full video.
brief.primary_action: Tap the reel card to open the existing full player sheet.
brief.friction: The live card displays static simulated controls on top of a real player, making the preview look paused and duplicating the play cue.

kpi.baseline: UNKNOWN: no comparable production interaction-to-inquiry cohort was read for this repair.
kpi.evidence: A fresh public 390x844 inspection found the duplicated cue and confirmed that the iframe mounts when the card enters view.
kpi.decision_rule: Retain only if the production playback remains usable and the existing interaction is measurable without a visual regression.

concept.idea: A real muted looping video preview inside the existing phone-shaped card.
concept.brand_reason: A production portfolio should show the actual motion rather than imitate player controls.
concept.interaction: The preview starts when the card becomes the visible carousel item; selecting the card keeps the existing full player sheet.
concept.visible_response: The live YouTube video replaces the still with no fabricated progress strip or second play control.
concept.direct_path: The existing in-page player sheet remains the direct full-video route.
concept.alternatives: No new control, no extra CTA, and no claim that playback produces inquiries.

story.opening: The selected-work carousel reaches the Great Reviewer card.
story.action: The card becomes the visible carousel item.
story.consequence: The muted inline preview plays and loops.
story.next_step: Tap the card to open the existing full player sheet.

content.visible: Existing title, source label and category remain visible.
content.optional_html: The existing full player sheet remains client-rendered after selection.
content.linked_depth: The existing portfolio route remains the no-JavaScript fallback.

references.borrow: Existing HomePortfolioRail, ReelFunnel and YouTube no-cookie embed.
references.avoid: Simulated playback progress, decorative duplicate play buttons and static-only video cards.

components.reuse: HomePortfolioRail, ReelFunnel and existing carousel analytics.
components.local_reason: The displayed player and looping source are specific to supported video portfolio cards.

verification.rendered_states: 390x844 phone and desktop, with the lead card visible and after selection.
verification.motion: Muted inline autoplay when visible; no motion is required under reduced-motion preference.
verification.accessibility_performance: One interactive card path, no new button, no preloaded offscreen player.
verification.raw_html: The existing title/category and fallback route remain served in the card markup.
verification.conversion_boundary: Existing full-player and inquiry paths remain unchanged.

reviewers.outcome: cto-product-lead at T+14 if comparable production events are available.
